warning_validity.sole_spine: event-conditioned temporal precedence is not predictive warning validity
warning_validity.claim_ceiling: The six frozen rules have specificity 0 and binary-marker AUC 0.5 in both tested ensembles; this does not imply that genetic diversity contains no predictive information generally.

state_validity.sole_spine: candidate states require endpoint-relevant adequacy and information-preserving representation before residual origin or history is tested
state_validity.claim_ceiling: Finite and system-specific tests do not establish state completeness, operator equivalence, habitat irrelevance, or validated predictive warning.
